worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.summary: Slam psychic force into the chosen ground: a local impact at the landing point leaves a psychic terrain that slows grounded foes. Cast it while standing on one and it absorbs the field instead, detonating around you to hit every nearby foe for more, then spreads a fresh field underfoot.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.descrip: Deals about %1$s special damage within %2$s blocks of the chosen landing point.
Spreads a psychic terrain of radius %1$s blocks at the landing point for %2$s s; while it lasts, grounded enemies inside have their movement slowed, while allies and airborne targets are unaffected.

If the user is grounded on a psychic terrain, it absorbs the field instead and detonates around itself within %1$s blocks, hitting every foe in range at 1.5x power, then spreads a fresh terrain under itself.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.prefere: Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to spread terrain; when off it stays put.
Counting within 6 blocks of yourself when detonating, or of the landing point on a normal cast: this many enemies raises the cast to a high priority; a higher threshold is harder to trigger.
